candidates.title: Canonical Component Registry
candidates.transformation: Rebaseline legend to distinguish intended vs operational vs incomplete vs transitional vs frozen-legacy vs unverified-local; demote apps/web, apps/admin, apps/api from unqualified Canonical; align messaging with Baseline RabbitMQ MVP; cite tracked evidence only.
candidates.rationale: High value inventory but over-claims operational/canonical status for incomplete or untracked components.
candidates.evidence_support: frontend-app tracked and used as pilot UI (Gap Note + 108 tracked files). backend/ has 72 local routers untracked. Baseline §4.7 RabbitMQ.
candidates.evidence_contradict: Tracked apps/api has 20 files, no main.ts, app.module imports untracked modules → not buildable on clean clone. apps/web and apps/admin exist locally with 0 tracked files. Registry Canonical labels conflict with OQ-3/OQ-4.

candidates.title: Legacy Deprecation Matrix
candidates.transformation: Verify each row against tracked/untracked status; add evidence-required column; forbid interpreting Phase labels as authorization to extend legacy; align Kafka/RabbitMQ row with Baseline.
candidates.rationale: Useful strangler map; must not authorize FastAPI tracking or legacy extension.
candidates.evidence_support: 72 backend/routers/*.py present locally (untracked). Keycloak/Nest pilot references in Gap Note and strangler criteria.
candidates.evidence_contradict: Treats apps/api as ready replacement while tracked apps/api incomplete. frontend-app is operational canonical per OQ-4, not merely Phase-4 deprecation candidate without supersession.

candidates.title: Enterprise Monorepo Structure
candidates.transformation: Rename to ARCHITECTURE.md; add current-vs-target views; link registry/ADRs; remove Kafka-as-default; document frontend-app operational; apps/api incomplete.
candidates.rationale: Natural architecture root but currently target-only and contradicts repository reality.
candidates.evidence_support: Monorepo layout aspirational; packages/* partially tracked.
candidates.evidence_contradict: Kafka vs Baseline RabbitMQ; no tracked apps/web|admin|worker; frontend-app is operational not merely legacy mapping.

candidates.title: ADR-001 Frontend Architecture
candidates.transformation: Formal supersession ADR (recommended) stating Next.js remains target; frontend-app is operational canonical until parity exit criteria; freeze growth of frontend-app features except pilot maintenance.
candidates.rationale: Historically Accepted but contradicted by OQ-4 and Gap Note; must not silently remain Accepted-as-current.
candidates.evidence_support: Baseline §4.1 target Next.js; apps/web|admin exist locally (untracked).
candidates.evidence_contradict: frontend-app 108 tracked files, Vite operational; Gap Note says not frozen for pilot; apps/web|admin 0 tracked.

candidates.title: ADR-002 Backend Architecture
candidates.transformation: Rebaseline: NestJS intended canonical; OQ-3 OPEN incomplete tracked state; messaging RabbitMQ MVP / Kafka post-MVP via ADR; FastAPI not canonical.
candidates.rationale: Core backend ADR but Kafka row and implicit completeness conflict with Baseline and OQ-3.
candidates.evidence_support: Nest intended in Baseline §4.2; packages/shared-kernel partial; deploy-backend containment.
candidates.evidence_contradict: Tracked apps/api incomplete; Kafka not MVP per Baseline §4.7 and ADR_ALIGNMENT_NOTE; backend/ FastAPI local untracked.

candidates.title: ADR-003 Database Strategy
candidates.transformation: Rebaseline: PostgreSQL+Prisma intended; packages/database 0 tracked; root prisma local-only; tenant_id mandatory as requirement not verified completeness.
candidates.rationale: Core data ADR; schema location claims need honesty.
candidates.evidence_support: Baseline DB rules; shared-kernel tenant helpers tracked.
candidates.evidence_contradict: packages/database untracked (0 files); prisma/schema.prisma local untracked; OQ-7.

candidates.title: ADR-004 Vector Search and RAG
candidates.transformation: Keep pgvector+RAG intent; mark ai-service status unverified/local; no autonomous certification.
candidates.rationale: Useful AI retrieval ADR; implementation not verified tracked.

candidates.transformation: Rebaseline OQ-5 DIRECTIONAL; packages/auth contracts untracked; SoD as requirement.
candidates.rationale: Identity ADR must not claim complete RBAC/SoD.

candidates.title: ADR-006 AI Governance

candidates.evidence_contradict: packages/audit 0 tracked; Kafka vs RabbitMQ; OQ-7 OPEN.

candidates.evidence_contradict: packages/database 0 tracked; OQ-7 OPEN; document claims need evidence refresh.

candidates.title: Shared Kernel Standard
